page.layout: One text column; marginal note block in the left margin beside the upper-middle lines. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: traque Amalum flumen, (hujus enim factionis principem & patronum se Albertus profitebatur) suftulerunt animos: Et cùm istuc quoque ab Alberto legati de deditione venissent, filius Occonis Broecmerij jam extincti Widsfeldus, & cum eo FolcmarusPactio quorundam è nobilitate cum Alberto Bavaro contra libertatem patriæ. Allena Osterhusanus, ad ipsum profecti, se & totam illam Orientalem Frisiam, quæ Comitatus nomine hodie censetur, ei tradiderunt hac lege, ut eandem in feudum ab ipso mox reciperent, fierentque ejus beneficiarii. Hoc vero fecêre, cum faciendi ejus jus omnino nullum haberent. Cùm his idem fecêre horum exemplo, animati è Nobilitate quidam in agro hoc Groningano, numero sex, Ailco Onstenius Ferhildemæus, Reinerus Eizingius, Tammo Gockingius, Menno Howerdæus, Omco Snelgeri, Haijo Wibenius, quorum animi jamdudum factionum & rerum novarum studio prurierant: à quibus totus inter Lavicam & Dullartum ager velut ex æquo & bono divisus, ac Alberto datus, ab Alberto verò ipsis in feudum redditus. page.notes: The left margin note is set in small italic type and runs over several lines; it is transcribed as one note at the point beside "Folcmarus". The first word "Amalum" is read with some doubt (possible tilde over the u). The running head and page number are read as printed.
